integrity: The upper bound is analytic, using only the exact Euclidean inradius/circumradius sandwich and the parallelogram identity. The lower bound is an explicit all-n construction using two orthogonal vertices and the ratio tan(pi/(4n)). The bundled numerical checker is supplementary and does not stand in for the proof. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers the Euclidean regular 4n-gonal Banach planes, up to linear isometry. It does not determine the extended James constant for regular polygons with 4n+2 sides, arbitrary centrally symmetric polygons, or all maximizers.
title: Extended James constant of every regular fourfold polygonal plane
